name: narrow an interval by successive symbol probabilities
mechanism: start with the unit interval and for each symbol shrink to the sub-interval proportional to that symbol's probability given the model; emit enough digits to identify the final interval, so the code length approaches the information content

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Arithmetic coding' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms: advanced entropy coding
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Range encoding': same as arithmetic coding, but looked at in a slightly different way
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Shannon–Fano–Elias coding': precursor to arithmetic encoding

requires: a probability model shared with the decoder (the model is where compression comes from)
